steps.label: HPA controller
steps.sub: compares actual metric to target, adjusts replicas

steps.label: Continuous
steps.sub: scales up for Black Friday, back down after

code:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: checkout-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: checkout
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 30
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
caption: 70% utilization is measured against requested CPU — this is why setting requests isn't optional.

steps.label: minReplicas: 3
steps.sub: a floor — baseline redundancy even at near-zero traffic

steps.label: maxReplicas: 30
steps.sub: a ceiling — protects the cluster and the cloud bill
